title: Control flow [IF]
description:
You may be noticing that sometimes you dont want things to execute all the time. This is what `if` statements are for. They only execute when the condition is true. synatx:
```ts
if (condition) {
    code
}
```
## Assignment:
MeTube needs to check if a video should be recommended. If the video has more than 10000 views, print `Recommended!`. If not, print nothing.
